ticks.note: The first visit to `Settings`: there is nothing to remember yet, so both start in `Display` and `Brightness` (`screen` = 11).
Back `Home` (0). Both charts remember where `Settings` was.

Back to `Settings` with history. `MenuDeep`: `history` is deep, so `Settings` resumes in `Display`, and `Display` resumes in `Contrast` (12). `MenuShallow`: `shallow history` restores only the level directly inside `Settings`, so `Display` is resumed but starts again in `Brightness` (11).
`Display` to `Sound`, which starts in `Volume` (21) in both.
Deep history resumes `Sound` and, inside it, `Balance` (22). Shallow history resumes `Sound`, starting in `Volume` (21).
